metadata.title: Sharp boundedness criteria for nonnegative kernels on regular curves in the Heisenberg group
metadata.abstract: In this paper we study singular integrals associated with the nonnegative kernels \[ K_\alpha(x,y,z)=\frac{|z|^{\alpha/2}}{\|(x,y,z)\|^{\alpha+1}}, \qquad \alpha>0, \] in the first Heisenberg group $\mathbb H$, where $\|\cdot\|$ denotes the Korányi norm. This family was introduced by Chousionis and Li. We first show that there exists a compact $1$-Ahlfors regular horizontal $C^1$ curve $E\subset\mathbb H$ such that the singular integrals associated with $K_\alpha$ are unbounded on $L^2(E)$ for every $0<\alpha<4$. This extends the counterexamples of Chousionis, Li and Zhang from $0<\alpha<2$ to the full range $0<\alpha<4$. Combined with the boundedness theorem of Fässler and Orponen for $\alpha\ge4$, our result determines the exact range of exponents for boundedness on every $1$-Ahlfors regular curve. We also consider the more general kernels \[ K_\Phi(p)=\frac{1}{\|p\|} \Phi\!\left(\frac{|z|^{1/2}}{\|p\|}\right), \qquad p=(x,y,z)\neq0, \] where $\Phi:[0,1]\to[0,\infty)$ is continuous and nondecreasing, with $\Phi(0)=0$. We show that the associated singular integral is $L^2$-bounded on every $1$-Ahlfors regular curve if and only if $\Phi(u)=O(u^4)$ as $u\to0$. When this condition fails, we construct a compact $1$-Ahlfors regular horizontal $C^1$ curve on which the operator is unbounded. The curves in both constructions can be chosen as horizontal lifts of planar $C^1$ graphs with arbitrarily small slope.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 构造紧一维 Ahlfors 正则水平 C¹ 曲线，使指定非负核在所有 0<α<4 时 L² 无界，结合已有 α≥4 正面定理确定阈值，并推广为 Φ(u)=O(u⁴) 的充要条件。
analysis.breakthrough: 把已知反例区间从 α<2 推至完整临界阈值四。
analysis.limitations: 判据要求 Φ 连续、非负、非降且 Φ(0)=0；讨论的是对每条正则曲线一致成立的类别性结论。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 对稿件提供反馈，协助文献比较及投稿声明措辞和 TikZ 制图；数学陈述与证明保留作者原稿内容。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.27730v1 · 第12页 Use of AI assistance
